notes: Schematic image was not viewable; the wiring is reconstructed from the text (I2S mic on A6/2/3, N-channel MOSFET + 2.2k pull-down + diode for the DC motor, N-channel MOSFET + 2.2k pull-up for the 5V servo signal, 0.1uF and 100uF noise capacitors). Exact breadboard columns are my own layout.
Pin numbers for the DC motor gate (pin 0) and servo signal (pin 1) are assumptions; the manual does not state them.

The catalogue arduino-mkr-zero entry does not list ports A6, 2 and 3, which this circuit uses; the names are used anyway. The catalogue 'servo' entry has no ports, so GND, SIGNAL and 5V are used, matching the servo label (1=GND, 2=Signal, 3=5V).
MOSFET type: both N-channel MOSFETs are modelled as mosfet-2n7000 (the photo shows TO-220 parts). The 100uF electrolytic uses capacitor-10uf with value=100uF.
Servo MOSFET: gate to 3.3V (VCC), source to MKR pin, drain to servo signal with the 2.2k pull-up to 5V. The ICS43432 LR pin is tied to GND. The MKR 'VCC' (3.3V) pin powers the microphone.
The 100uF capacitor sits across the 5V and GND rails near the servo. The 0.1uF ceramic capacitor is soldered across the DC motor terminals, as seen in the photo.
The flyback diode runs from the MOSFET drain column (anode) to the 5V rail (cathode).
The laser-cut MDF box, wheel, lifting arm, rubber band, hot glue and card stock are mechanical and are not modelled; the rubber band has no ports to join to.
